lines.text: Levi said she'd make something marvelous and told me to gather the materials.
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, considered this matter with the utmost gravity.
How, I wonder, shall I procure the materials that Levi requires?
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, overheared the others' plans:
Ziz will take to the skies, and Behemoth will traverse on foot.
Once more, I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, pondered the matter.
Then I shall, with my mighty legs, leap tirelessly and gather a great abundance!
Truly, I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, am the epitome of genius!
